for k in range(20):
    p0=np.array([0.0023,0.7,2.2,-0.3,0.026])*(1+0.05*np.random.randn(5))
    r=least_squares(lambda p:(f(p)-s)/np.abs(s).mean(), p0, max_nfev=4000, xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15)
    if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
p=best.x; res=s-f(p)
print(np.round(p,5), np.mean(res**2)/np.var(s))
